description: The film's background music: add the person's music file (it's levelled so it sits under the voice; the levelled copy replaces it by itself a minute or two later), set its volume and how far it drops under the voice, or remove it. One undo step. Returns the music settings. For short sounds at a moment, use upload as sound or sound_effects.

duck.description: How far it drops under the voice, dB 0 to 24. Default 12.

name.description: A name for it. Default: the file name.

path.description: Full path of a music file on this computer.

name: music
